__metadata__.name: SLKB - Synthetic Lethality Knowledge Base
__metadata__.description: Gene-pair synthetic lethality (SL) relations harmonized from 11 published CRISPR combinatorial double-knockout (CDKO) screens across 22 cancer cell lines, including each study's original SL classification/score and 7 independently re-calculated SL scoring methods (Horlbeck, MAGeCK, GEMINI, Median-B/NB, sgRNA-derived-B/NB).
